people.imagined: In the worm shed at the reel, judging the year's bolts. The nail of her left thumb is worn away to a smooth pink. She holds up one thread to the light and decides a grade she will lie about.
people.subject: The moment: in a worm shed filled with soft steam she holds a single pale silk thread up between finger and thumb against the light, checking its draw, with a veiled look. Face: the left thumb, held up in front, has no nail at all, worn to a smooth shiny pink pad with a faint ridge where the nail was, and the thread is stretched taut from it. A narrow, composed, sallow face of about forty; pale skin; long-lidded dark eyes; thin neat brows; a thin straight nose; a small closed mouth with a hint of secrecy. Hair: black, in a tight low knot held with a bone hairpin and a thin silver comb. Body: slight, upright, still. Clothing: layered robes of the finest cream silk that seems to glow, two crossed collars, a translucent gauze over-robe woven with faint clouds, wide sleeves gathered at the wrist with silk cords; the grey-green sash of an inner disciple tied with a jade bead; a small bamboo reel with a worn red cord hangs at her chest. Hands and objects: the taut thread between the left thumb and forefinger, the right hand loosely holding a bamboo reel handle; her other nails neatly trimmed. Power: a faint green-gold haze of wood qi curls in the steam about her fingers. Background: blurred rows of trays and pale hanks of silk glowing softly in drifting mist. Light: soft spirit-light from a paper window at the upper left, a gentle glowing rim along her sleeve. Expression: a veiled, reserved face with lowered lids and closed lips, eyes slow and unrevealing.

people.imagined: He turns his wrists to show his cuffs, which are fire-silk a rank above his own, to the viewer as if by accident. He is pricing the season in his head.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a loom bench he turns both wrists outward to display his cuffs to the viewer, smiling as if by accident, pricing the season in his head. Face: his cuffs of glossy ember-red fire-silk, visibly richer than the cream sleeves they sit on, are turned out toward the viewer. A handsome, smooth, shrewd face of about thirty-five, light brown in skin, with sharp dark eyes, neat arched brows, a straight nose and a half-smile. Hair: black, oiled and tied in a neat topknot with a red silk cord and a small gold pin. Body: medium height, well groomed, a little vain in his posture. Clothing: layered robes of pressed cream silk that glows softly, two crossed collars, a gauze over-robe woven with clouds, wide sleeves; the grey-green inner-disciple sash with a small jade bead the size of a pea; and the red fire-silk cuffs, a rank above his own, woven with tiny flames. Hands and objects: both wrists turned out, fingers spread, the cuffs shimmering as if lit from within, a faint warm orange glow on the cloth while the cream sleeves beneath are soft and pale. Power: a few orange sparks of fire qi and a green thread of wood qi drift around the cuffs, restrained and tidy. Background: blurred looms with pale silk and a hearth glowing red through drifting mist. Light: warm hearth spirit-light from the lower left, orange sparks falling onto the loom frames, a soft rim on the jaw. Expression: ambitious and pragmatic, a smooth, greedy composure, a man counting what the cuffs will fetch.

people.imagined: A lake girl stretches silk on a banner frame, unseen and forgettable; the boys forget her name by tomorrow. She has seen the draft of the great banner and keeps it behind her calm smile.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a banner frame she pulls a sheet of white silk taut and glances up with a small content smile; she has seen the draft of the great banner and keeps it behind her calm face. Face: an ordinary round, pleasant face that is easily forgotten, with a short bamboo tension pin held between her teeth. She is sixteen, light brown in skin, with soft grey-brown eyes, plain level brows, a small nose and a friendly mouth around the pin. Hair: dark brown, in two plain braids pinned up on her head with a pale ribbon. Body: small, sturdy and slightly rounded, with stubby fingers pink from tugging the silk. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple silk, a clean new cream jacket-robe with two crossed collars, a soft gauze over-sleeve, narrow sleeves tucked up with cords, and the pale beige sash of an outer disciple tied in a plain bow. Hands and objects: both hands grip the edge of a bamboo frame with white silk stretched over it, so fine that the light shows through it like milk. Power: a faint green-teal haze of qi shimmers in the air above the silk, barely there. Background: tall bamboo frames and hanging pale silks in soft mist, a window. Light: gentle silvery spirit-light from the upper left, a faint glowing rim along her braids. Expression: a small, pleasant, forgettable smile with soft eyes and a smooth, unreadable brow.

people.imagined: He bends over a worm tray with his ear pressed to it, listening for a worm that has stopped spinning, and has already chosen the one to drop in the pit.
people.subject: The moment: bent sideways with his right ear pressed against the rim of a tray, he listens in silence, eyes half closed, about to make a hard choice. Face: one ear pressed flat to a tray of silkworms, and a pair of thin steel tweezers poised in his hand. A long, calm, pale face of twenty-five; light skin; hooded grey eyes; thin brows; a long nose; a mouth set neutral and cold. Hair: dark brown, cropped close but for a loose strand, held by a plain jade pin. Body: tall, narrow, stooped. Clothing: layered robes of clean cream silk with a soft glow, two crossed collars, a pale mulberry-leaf green gauze over-robe, wide sleeves tied back with cord; the grey-green sash of an inner disciple with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: tweezers of thin steel with a bright tip raised in the right hand, the left holding the tray edge; the silkworms in the tray are pale and soft, chewing with a faint rustling. Power: a faint pale-green mist of wood qi lies over the tray and gathers at his ear. Background: blurred rows of trays with mulberry leaves in a dim shed, drifting mist. Light: low warm lamp spirit-light from the left, leaving a sharp bright line on his cheekbone and throwing his eye sockets into shadow. Expression: half-closed eyes and a calm, still mouth, the face devoid of sorrow as he listens.

people.imagined: At the market table, counting bolts in a clerk's whisper, losing count on purpose, his lips moving. He thinks of his mother in Tang Âm.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a market table he counts in a whisper with moving lips, a finger lightly tapping bolts of silk, eyes down, trusting and a little furtive, losing count on purpose while he thinks of his mother. Face: lips shaped around whispered numbers, and a stack of rolled silk bolts, each tied with a different coloured cord, piled in the lower frame in front of him. A plain, open, boyish face of twenty-four, olive-skinned, with brown anxious eyes, thick uneven brows, a wide nose and a hopeful half-smile. Hair: black and short, a cap of brown cloth pushed back and sitting crooked, a small wooden pin. Body: medium height and narrow-shouldered. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple silk, a clean pale robe with two crossed collars and a light gauze over-robe, narrow sleeves rolled to the elbow, a loader's rope sash over the beige outer sash, a small brass tally bead on a thong at the collar. Hands and objects: a finger resting on a bolt; the bolts tied with cords of red, blue, yellow and green and stacked three high. Power: a faint brown-orange haze of earth qi sits in the air above the bolts. Background: blurred market awnings in pale blue and white hung with glowing silks in mist. Light: bright silvery spirit-light from the upper left striping through the awnings, a soft rim on his cheek. Expression: trusting and diligent, a little guilty, the unguarded worry of a boy who is not as honest as he looks.

people.imagined: She has just set a sleeve alight 'by accident' in the charring room, and looks at her own right hand's burn-shiny fingertips with satisfaction, counting seasons.
people.subject: The moment: in the charring room she looks calmly at her own raised right hand with a small honest smile, a rival's cry fading behind her; she has just set a sleeve alight by accident and is counting seasons. Face: the fingertips of her right hand only are burn-shiny, smooth and glossy as polished horn and a little darker than the rest of the hand, held up before her face, while the left hand is ordinary. A sharp, pretty, ambitious face of nineteen, light olive in skin, with dark amber eyes holding a bright glint, arched brows, a small straight nose and a smile with a cruel curl. Hair: dark chestnut, in a high twist pinned by a red lacquer shuttle as long as a chopstick. Body: slim, quick and poised. Clothing: layered cream silk robes with a soft glow, two crossed collars and wide sleeves, a gauze over-robe woven with clouds, the hem of one sleeve scorched brown and curled along a neat line; the deep red sash of a fire-setter tied with a jade tassel. Hands and objects: the right hand raised with the glossy fingertips toward the viewer, a faint orange-red warmth around them. Power: small flames of fire qi flicker at her fingertips and a few red sparks drift past her cheek. Background: a dim room with a haze of blue smoke drifting and an orange hearth glow, blurred. Light: orange hearth spirit-light from the lower left shifting across her cheek, a thin rim of gold on her hair. Expression: ambitious and honest, a quietly cruel satisfaction in the eyes and the small curve of the mouth.

people.imagined: A vat-stirrer at night copying a mordant by lamp, stained faintly blue to the hairline. She knows she will undercut the old dyer's grandchildren at the stalls.
people.subject: The moment: at night by a single lamp she bends over a small vat with a stirring paddle, copying a recipe from memory, eyes lifted guardedly at the viewer; she knows she will undercut the old dyer's grandchildren at the stalls. Face: her whole skin is faintly blue-tinged from the hairline down the face and neck, as if the vats had marked her, deepest at the hairline and under the nails and fading to a faint violet on the cheeks. A narrow, still face of twenty-seven with small dark eyes, thin straight brows, a thin nose and closed lips. Hair: black, in a plain wrap of undyed gauze tied at the nape, a loose wisp blue at the temple. Body: small, wiry and bent over the work. Clothing: a servant's clean, simple robe of indigo-spotted silk-linen in the pavilion's cream, with two crossed collars and sleeves rolled up, the forearms blue to the elbow, and a plain sash; neat and graceful though plain, as a servant's dress. Hands and objects: a long wooden paddle, dark with dye, stirring a vat whose surface shines like blue-black ink. Power: a faint blue shimmer of water qi rises from the vat and clings to her wrists. Background: a dark dye shed with indigo cloths hanging in long folds of different depths, from sky to midnight, in mist. Light: a soft yellow lamp from the lower left, deep blue shadow, a pale silver rim on her cheek. Expression: patient and reclusive, a closed, faithless composure, a look that gives nothing to the viewer.

people.imagined: A tall quick woman standing at her loom, a red shuttle stuck through her hair like a pin, burn-pale fingertips flexing. She is imagining a banner that will outlast the palace's.
people.subject: The moment: a tall woman at a great loom looks up impatiently, a red shuttle stuck through her hair, burn-pale fingertips flexing at her chest as she imagines a banner that will outlast the palace's. Face: a long red lacquered shuttle, cinnabar red with a brass tip, thrust through the knot of her hair like a hairpin. A sharp, strong, quick face of about forty-five, light brown in skin, with dark intense eyes, thick straight brows, a high-bridged nose and a hard thin mouth. Hair: black with streaks of grey, wound in a high knot with the red shuttle and a small gold crown of woven filigree. Body: tall, straight and restless. Clothing: the head's richest dress: layered robes of glowing cream silk, three crossed collars, an over-robe of woven-cloud brocade that shifts colour like the evening sky, wide sleeves tied back with scarlet silk cord; a founder's deep scarlet sash with jade pendants, and a small fire-silk panel at the cuff glowing a dull ember as if breathing. Hands and objects: both hands raised at her chest with the fingers flexing, the fingertips pale, smooth and almost glassy with old scar. Power: a strong aura of red-gold fire qi and green wood qi swirls about her like silk threads in the air, with ember motes rising. Background: a great loom behind her strung with hundreds of fine taut threads that catch the light like rain, blurred in mist. Light: strong warm spirit-light from the upper left with orange sparks at the loom, a bright rim along her shoulder. Expression: ambitious and impatient, a hard, callous eagerness in the mouth, a woman who has already decided what the others will weave.

people.imagined: The guest dyer in the dye yard at morning, with blue hands lifted from a vat, smelling of indigo, wanting only one more year of indigo for her town's children.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a dye vat in a yard at morning, an old guest dyer lifts both blue hands dripping from the liquid and looks calmly at the viewer, wanting only one more year of indigo for her town's children. Face: both hands and forearms dyed deep blue to the wrist, raised and dripping, the blue strong around the nails and knuckles and rising up the arms to the elbow in an uneven line. An old, lined, serene face of about seventy-five, brown and wrinkled, with clear pale grey-blue eyes, white eyebrows, a hooked nose and a small calm mouth. Hair: white, in a low bun wrapped in an indigo gauze cloth and held by a silver pin. Body: small, bent slightly and steady. Clothing: a guest elder's robe, flowing indigo-dyed silk in several shades from pale to deep blue, two crossed collars, a drifting over-robe of pale blue gauze, wide sleeves pushed up; a small polished blue stone the size of a quail's egg on a cord at the neck, glowing softly. Hands and objects: both hands raised, wet and blue, drips falling back into the vat with small rings. Power: a gentle blue aura of water qi lies about her like a morning mist, with pale motes lifting from the vat. Background: a blurred yard of hanging indigo cloths of every shade moving in the breeze, a whole sky of blues. Light: clear silvery morning spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim on her white hair. Expression: calm and reclusive, the settled contentment of a woman who has made peace with her own colour.

people.imagined: A small careful woman in the worm shed carries silkworms in her sleeve to keep them warm. She holds the sleeve open and looks into it before she looks at you.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a warm worm shed, she cups her opened sleeve in front of her and looks tenderly into it before looking up. Face: her wide sleeve held open, showing a nest of small pale silkworms moving in the folds, and a calm, careful face. Age about sixty; a small round lined face; brown skin; kind sharp dark eyes; thin grey brows; a small nose; a prim mouth. Hair: grey, in a tight low bun with a bamboo hairpin and a small jade comb. Body: small, round-shouldered, still. Clothing: an elder's dress: layered robes of glowing cream silk with a high collar, mended with careful stitches, a gauze over-robe woven with soft clouds, long wide sleeves; an elder's grey-green silk sash with a thin red edge, a jade pendant at the hip; a small bamboo tray on a cord at her chest holding three mulberry leaves. Hands and objects: one hand holds the open sleeve, the other covers it protectively; the silkworms are as small as rice grains, pale and wriggling, and she lowers her face over them so her breath warms them. Power: a gentle pale-green aura of wood qi surrounds her, and tiny green motes drift into the sleeve like warmth. Background: blurred trays of mulberry leaves and a warm lamp in soft mist. Light: warm lamp spirit-light from the lower left, orange against the green-grey sash, a soft glowing rim on her hair. Expression: a tender, careful look with lowered eyes and a soft, hushed smile.

people.imagined: At the market table haggling, twisting a too-small ring on his finger. He has just lost again to the palace's factor and is already planning to take his tenth.
people.subject: The moment: haggling across a table, he twists a ring on one finger with the thumb of the same hand, smiling falsely, while the other hand is raised in a bargaining gesture. Face: a ring on every finger, ten rings glinting, the smallest visibly too tight, pinching the finger. A florid, round, sleek face of about forty-two; ruddy skin; shrewd small black eyes; a thin neat moustache; a snub nose; a wide, smiling mouth. Hair: black, oiled and combed, with a small gold cap pin and a topknot tied with green silk. Body: stout, with a round belly, expansive in gesture. Clothing: layered robes of glowing cream silk, two crossed collars, a rich dark-red brocade waistcoat over them woven with clouds, wide sleeves, a factor's green sash with a jade pendant and a small abacus-shaped brass charm at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands in front, rings glittering; the ten rings are of jade, gold, silver and plain iron, one with a red stone, and the smallest on the right little finger is sunk into the flesh so the skin bulges around it; bolts of bright silk are heaped on the table. Power: a faint metallic gleam of gold-white qi plays on the rings and a few warm motes on his sleeves. Background: a blurred market with awnings and stacked glowing silk in mist. Light: bright silvery spirit-light from the upper left, a gold rim on the rings and cheek. Expression: a false, bright smile with eyes that stay hard and watchful, a muscle tight at the jaw.

people.imagined: The embroiderer looks first at the viewer's hands, before the face, with a needle silver at her lapel, weighing them. She dislikes a thread colour and decides.
people.subject: The moment: seated at an embroidery frame, she looks first at the viewer's hands, her gaze lowered and critical, a silver needle pinned through her lapel. Face: a long silver needle pinned through the lapel of her robe, glinting at the chest, and eyes cast down and sideways in appraisal. A fine, cool, pale face of forty; porcelain skin; narrow dark eyes; arched thin brows; a long straight nose; thin lips in a pinched line. Hair: black, in a very neat chignon with a single silver comb and a jade hairpin. Body: slim, erect, elegant. Clothing: layered robes of glowing cream silk, three crossed collars, a gauze over-robe woven with fine clouds, an indigo-dyed collar and cuffs in a delicate shade, wide sleeves; a pale rose sash with a jade tassel. Hands and objects: one hand holds an embroidery hoop with a half-worked cloud pattern in three shades of pink and gold on cream; the silver needle in her lapel is long and fine with a tiny bead head and a thread of rose silk trailing from it; her hands pale and slender with spotless nails. Power: a faint green-gold haze of wood and fire qi lies over the hoop, the stitches glimmering. Background: blurred banners of coloured silk without writing, a window, drifting mist. Light: cool silvery moonlight from the upper left, a thin glowing rim along her chin. Expression: a cool, critical gaze with lowered lids, one brow arched and a thin, superior mouth.

people.imagined: She has just set the fire in a best bolt and singed her own eyebrow again, and wants to try a vent. She grins before the smoke clears.
people.subject: The moment: in a haze of smoke she grins eagerly with a pleased, flushed face, having just lit a thread; she has set fire to a best bolt and singed her own eyebrow again, and wants to try a vent. Face: her left eyebrow is singed down to short charred stubble while the right is full and dark, clearly uneven, and a soot smudge shaped like a thumb marks her cheek. A round, bold, rosy face of twenty-two, warm brown in skin, with bright dark eyes, a bold nose and a wide grin. Hair: dark brown, pinned with a red lacquer shuttle, a front curl scorched brown at the tip. Body: sturdy and vigorous, leaning in toward the flame. Clothing: layered cream silk robes with a soft glow, two crossed collars and wide sleeves, the cuffs scorched at the edge by her work, a gauze over-robe woven with clouds; the deep red sash of a fire-setter with a jade tassel, and a single blackened silk glove on the left hand. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a small clay lamp with a bright yellow flame, a faint red-orange glow at the fingers. Power: a vivid aura of red-orange fire qi crackles about her shoulders, bright sparks swirling, stronger than any junior's. Background: a blurred charring room with an orange glow and drifting smoke. Light: orange firelight spirit-glow from the lower left, a hot gold rim along her cheek. Expression: delighted and brave, impatient, an ambitious grin that comes before the smoke has cleared.

people.imagined: She feeds the worms and names them; she has just come away from the pit with wet eyes and a thread tied around her wrist bearing a cocoon's name.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a pit with a basket of mulberry leaves, she wipes her wet eyes with the back of a wrist and looks up with a trembling smile. Face: a fine thread tied around her wrist with a tiny cocoon knotted into it, held up near her cheek, and wet, red-rimmed eyes. A small, soft, round face of twenty; pale pink skin; big dark brown eyes shining with tears; thin brows; a button nose; a wavering mouth. Hair: black, in two short braids tied with green yarn. Body: small, slight, hunched. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple silk, a clean cream jacket-robe with two crossed collars and a grass-green gauze overskirt, sleeves a little long and damp where she has wiped her eyes; the pale beige sash of the outer gate. Hands and objects: one hand holds the basket, half full of fresh mulberry leaves, on her arm; the other wipes her eye; the thread on her wrist is pale green with a tiny cocoon knotted in it. Power: a faint green glimmer of wood qi on the leaves, no more. Background: the edge of the pit dark and shadowed in mist, with the pale shapes of silk trays stacked behind. Light: soft silvery spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim on her wet cheek. Expression: wet, reddened eyes and a trembling smile, the lower lip unsteady and the cheeks damp.

people.imagined: After the lamps are out he reels extra cocoons at the pot, drawing a thread a mile long. His fingertips are boiled smooth. He does not know how well he draws.
people.subject: The moment: late at night over a steaming pot he draws a fine silk thread from a cocoon with perfect steadiness, looking up calm and a little tired; after the lamps are out he reels extra cocoons, and does not know how well he draws. Face: his fingertips are boiled completely smooth, with no prints at all, glossy and pink like polished shells, held in the steam, and a single unbroken thread rising from them, so fine it is only a glint. A plain, honest, steady face of twenty-four, fair and flushed by steam, with light brown eyes, straight brows, a straight nose and a closed, gentle mouth. Hair: dark brown, tied in a small knot with a jade pin, damp with steam. Body: lean and patient, precise in posture. Clothing: layered robes of clean cream silk with a soft glow, two crossed collars, a thin gauze over-robe woven with clouds, wide sleeves tied back with cord; the grey-green sash of an inner disciple with a jade bead. Hands and objects: the thread drawn between the fingertips above a squat iron pot with a bamboo lid; steam clings to his hair and eyelashes. Power: a faint green-gold shimmer of wood qi lies in the steam and along the thread, which glows like a strand of light. Background: a dark shed lit by a single small lamp that makes a warm gold spot on the wall, in drifting mist. Light: soft warm lamp spirit-light from the lower left, a pale rim on his cheek. Expression: diligent and calm, honest, the steady unhurried attention of a man for whom the thread is the only thing in the room.

people.imagined: A fisher girl who threads needles faster than anyone, with a fish-scale glitter on her cheek she swears is not paint, giggling at the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table, she threads a needle in one quick motion and grins at the viewer, delighted with herself. Face: a patch of glittering fish-scale shimmer on her left cheekbone, silver and blue, plainly visible, and a threaded needle held up. A round, quick, bright face of sixteen; tanned skin; sparkling dark eyes; thin arched brows; a small round nose; a wide grin. The shimmer is a scatter of tiny silver-blue flecks like spilled sequins. Hair: black, in a loose braid with a bright kingfisher-blue thread woven through. Body: small, quick, bouncy. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple silk, a cream jacket-robe with two crossed collars, a pale blue collar edge and a light gauze over-sleeve, narrow sleeves tied with thread; the beige sash of an outer disciple. Hands and objects: a long silver needle held up in the right hand with a thread through its eye. Power: a faint blue shimmer of water qi dances on her cheek and a few blue motes sparkle near the needle. Background: blurred embroidery frames and colourful silk without writing, splashes of coral, jade and saffron in soft mist. Light: bright silvery spirit-light from the upper left, a soft glowing rim along her braid. Expression: a delighted, gleeful grin with sparkling eyes and a scrunched nose, fish-scale glitter on one cheek.

people.imagined: An old leaf-picker whistles through a gap in her teeth under a mulberry row. She has left the high rows unpicked and carries gossip. She is content and does not hurry.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a mulberry row, an old leaf-picker whistles cheerfully through a gap in her teeth, a big basket on her back; she has left the high rows unpicked and carries gossip, and she does not hurry. Face: a gap where the left front tooth was, a dark notch in her pursed whistling mouth, under a wide woven conical hat with a broad brim. She appears about seventy, with brown, sun-leathered skin creased by a thousand wrinkles, bright small black eyes, thin white eyebrows, a flat broad nose and a puckered mouth. Hair: thin white, tied in a bun under the hat. Body: short, strong and bent slightly. Clothing: a servant's clean, simple dress, a sturdy undyed jacket with a wide dark blue skirt and a leaf-green apron tied with a cloth sash, plain but tidy and edged in a thin line of cream silk; the sun-bleached conical hat has a chin cord of twisted straw. Hands and objects: both hands hold the straps of a basket piled with glossy green mulberry leaves. Power: a faint brown-gold haze of earth qi hangs in the air about the basket. Background: green mulberry rows running away in lines, sunlit leaves glowing in soft mist. Light: dappled bright spirit-light from the upper left, moving on her wrinkled cheeks. Expression: content and amused, lazy and forgiving, the easy, pleased pucker of a woman at peace with her work.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the weaver who tried first, at the age her hands burned to the bone: she looks stubbornly forward, her wrapped hands held in front of her.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like old silk, of a weaver holding her heavily bandaged hands up before her, looking forward with a stubborn, steady gaze. Face: both hands wrapped to the wrist in layered pale silk bandages stained faintly brown, held up in front. A lean, strong face of about fifty; brown skin with deep lines; fierce dark eyes; thick straight brows; a firm nose; a set mouth. Hair: black with grey, pulled back and tied in a plain knot with a single wooden pin. Body: lean, straight-backed. Clothing: an old flowing robe of cream silk gone soft and pale, two crossed collars, a thin gauze over-robe woven with faded clouds, wide plain sleeves, and a faded red sash; the dress of the house before it had its sheet. Hands and objects: the bandaged hands bound in layers of silk gone brown with stains, the fingers stiff and thick inside like paddles, a few threads of faded red escaping the wrapping. Power: a faint ember-red wash of fire qi around the hands, like the last glow of coals. Background: the dim shape of a loom with a single glowing red thread at its centre like a small ember, a muted dark wall. Light: soft pale glow from the upper left; the whole picture faded, soft-edged and yellowed like old silk. Expression: a stubborn, steady gaze with a firm, closed mouth and a lifted chin.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the master reeler of a burned town, at the age she barred the road with her reelers: calm, hands folded, a reel at her side.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like old silk, of the master reeler of a burned town at the age she barred the road with her reelers, standing at a doorway with her hands folded, calm and unyielding. Face: a small bamboo reel held against her chest in both hands, and a straight, steady face. She is about fifty, with a strong square face, weathered brown skin, deep-set steady dark eyes, thick grey eyebrows, a broad nose and a firm mouth. Hair: grey, in a neat tight bun with a bamboo hairpin and a simple silver pin. Body: solid and upright. Clothing: a flowing robe of plain undyed silk, cream gone soft with age, a high collar mended in careful stitches, a thin gauze over-robe, wide sleeves tied back, and a plain cord sash; a reeler's pale gauze apron over it; no sect's sheet, only the clean silk of a master of her craft. Hands and objects: the folded hands broad with reeler's calluses around the bamboo reel, worn pale and smooth, with a crank handle. Power: a faint warm amber glow of fire qi gathers at her shoulders, as if the burning town behind lit her from within. Background: a dim doorway and a faint orange glow behind it, the distant burning town in drifting smoke. Light: soft pale glow from the upper left; the whole picture faded, soft-edged and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, a faint orange wash at the borders. Expression: stubborn and brave, loyal, the level unmoving look of a woman who has decided where the road ends.
